name: set
usage:
set: (Built-In)
use: 
Simple Method:
    set <variablename|address[:<sizeinbytes>]> <integer>
 example:
    set FPGARegister1 0x81
    set 0xFF00FF00    0x81 (assumed as 32 bits.)
    set 0xFF00FF00:4
OR|AND'd Methods:
    set <variablename|address[:<sizeinbytes>]> <or|and> <integer>
 can be combined into one statement (always 'and' before 'or'):
    set <variablename|address[:<sizeinbytes>]> and <i1> or <i2>
 This method does a common OR|AND operation. Using this command
 same as doing in C: '|=' '&='
 example:
    set FPGARegister1 or 0x80
    set 0xFF00FF00:4 and 0x0000FF8F
    set 0xFF00FF00 and 0xFFFF0000 or 0x0000FF8F
Direct Bit Access:
    set <variablename|address[:<sizeinbytes>]> bit <integer> <on|off>
 example:
    set FPGARegister1 bit 2 on

name: gms
usage:
gms: (Built-In)
use: 
    gms <variablename|address[:<sizeinbytes>]> <clearmask> <setmask>
 identical to:
    set <variablename|address[:<sizeinbytes>]> and <and-mask> or <or-mask>
 where and-mask: bitwise-inverse of clearmask
    and or-mask: setmask
 modifies value speficified by variablename|address
    each bit set in clearmask clears bit in value
    each bit set in setmask sets bit in value
------------------------------------------------------------
Get-Modify-Set tool to modify a value

 example:
